def scan(P,lo,hi,n=6001):
    best=None
    for w in np.linspace(lo,hi,n):
        B=np.column_stack([P,np.cos(w*t),np.sin(w*t)])
        c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(B,dv_dt,rcond=None)
        e=np.mean((B@c-dv_dt)**2)/np.var(dv_dt)
        if best is None or e<best[0]: best=(e,w,c)
    return best
